result.title: Robust-GCD
result.summary: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) classifies an unlabeled pool that contains both known and novel classes, given labels for the known classes only. Existing GCD methods assume that every un- labeled image is clean, but unlabeled data collected in the wild is often degraded by blur, sensor noise and compression artifacts. We formalize the setting in which an unknown fraction of the unlabeled pool is corrupted by an unknown operator as Degraded Generalized Category Discovery (D-GCD). To tackle it, we propose Robust-GCD, a framework that estimates the corruption directly from the unlabeled pool and uses the estimate to build labeled anchors for known classes and pseudo-anchors for novel classes inside the corrupted region of feature space. A trust curriculum controls how much the unlabeled pool is trusted while the anchors take hold, and a paired alignment loss keeps a clean image and its corrupted twin close in feature space. Across five datasets and multiple corruption families, Robust-GCD recovers between 43% and 96% of the All accuracy that SimGCD loses under contamination, and more than 60% on four of the five datasets, with the largest gains on the corrupted images themselves.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 D-GCD 设定：无标注池中有一部分图像被未知算子损坏且比例未知；Robust-GCD 从无标注池中估计损坏程度，在特征空间的受污染区域构建已知类锚点与新颖类伪锚点，并用「信任课程」控制对无标注数据的依赖程度，配合配对对齐损失拉近干净图与损坏副本。
AI.relevance_reason: 视觉特征被损坏时的损坏估计与信任调度，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、不可靠视觉输入的降权与 latent 状态更新提供借鉴线索；但该工作是无生成推理的判别式分类，与 latent 推理状态的产生和停止决策无直接关系，需核查其锚点与信任机制能否迁移。
